title: P0.42: Post-load UI Freeze Remediation + Idle-Budgeted Metacognition
description: Eliminar congelamiento de UI post-load causado por _refresh_development_packet() sincronico en _apply_task_result(). La lectura de 120 dossiers JSON bloquea el hilo UI durante 67 segundos con CPU/RAM estables. Implementa politica idle-budgeted: diferir refresh si hay stall reciente, query pendiente o recurso bajo presion. Mover lectura pesada a background con budget de 1500ms.
reason: Evidencia viva: freeze_20260519_041113_823694.json reporta ui_event_loop_stall duration_ms=67156 con startup_active=false, query_pending=false, CPU/RAM estables. Stack: _apply_task_result -> _refresh_development_packet -> build_codex_packet -> build_project_context -> list_recent(limit=120) -> json.loads(). NO es resource_pressure; es starvation del hilo UI.
next_action: Live proof en Windows: (1) mergear PR, (2) abrir IABV, (3) esperar UI cargada, (4) no tocar nada 90s, (5) verificar runtime_audit.jsonl: no ui_event_loop_stall >5000ms, development_packet_refresh_deferred o background, nunca _refresh_development_packet sincronico desde _apply_task_result.
resume_hint: P0.42 implementado: _apply_task_result y _apply_task_failure ahora llaman _schedule_idle_dev_packet_refresh en vez de _refresh_development_packet sincronico. Si hay recent_ui_stall, query_pending, resource_pressure, non_critical_task o startup_followup_active, el refresh se difiere con timer. Si no hay razon para diferir, se ejecuta en _bg_pool con budget de 1500ms. Si excede budget, marca packet parcial con UNRESOLVED. OSES detecta: stable_resource_ui_starvation, repeated_post_load_ui_stall, dossier_json_io_main_thread. PortableContext exporta post_load_stability.

metadata.root_cause: post_load_ui_thread_dossier_json_io: _apply_task_result() llamaba _refresh_development_packet() sincrono en hilo UI. Este metodo invoca EngineeringReviewService.build_codex_packet() -> build_project_context() -> ExecutionDossierRepository.list_recent(limit=120) -> _load_from_path() -> json.loads(). 120 archivos JSON leidos secuencialmente en main thread. CPU/RAM estables — no es resource_pressure, es starvation pura.

evidence.bug: list_recent(limit=120) reads all dossier files sequentially

fixes_applied.task_b: _apply_task_result and _apply_task_failure now call _schedule_idle_dev_packet_refresh instead of _refresh_development_packet. Never synchronous on UI thread.
fixes_applied.task_c: _run_budgeted_dev_packet_refresh executes on _bg_pool with 1500ms budget. If exceeded, marks packet partial with UNRESOLVED.
fixes_applied.task_d: Idle-budgeted metacognition policy: _should_defer_dev_packet_refresh checks query_pending, recent_ui_stall, resource_pressure, non_critical_task, startup_followup_active. Stall increases cooldown to 15s.
fixes_applied.task_e_portable: PortableContext exports post_load_stability section: latest_stall_ms, dominant_cause, mitigation_status, pending_unresolved, recommended_next_action.
